title: Tofu, avo and almond salad
steps: Drain the tofu and press it between paper towels for a few minutes to dry it, then cut it into cubes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat with a few drops of the oil and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides. Add a splash of soy sauce for the last minute.
Chop the almonds roughly and slice the cucumber, tomato and avo.
Toss the spinach, cucumber and tomato with the rest of the oil and a squeeze of lemon, then top with the tofu, avo and almonds.
